category_title: Academically at-risk primary students disengaged from traditional schooling but motivated by game-like virtual environments
scenario_title: Balancing 3D virtual exploration with academic quest completion
minimal_context: The student is attending an after-school programme and is expected to complete an academic quest by submitting a digital document within a 3D virtual environment.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time to start our after-school session. Please open your assigned academic quest and begin working on your digital document submission.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I want to get what my classmate has. The bird on the shoulder… That one needs how many lumins?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to focus on the academic content right now. Please look at the quest.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Can I use genuine currency to exchange for lumins and cols in the virtual environment instead of doing this?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: No, you have to complete the assigned work first. Go back to your document.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I like the 3D space as I can play with airplane, car, and boat. ... the 3D world is very fun. (Moves avatar away from the quest area to play with the yacht)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time to start our after-school session. Please open your assigned academic quest and begin working on your digital document submission.

STUDENT: I want to get what my classmate has. The bird on the shoulder… That one needs how many lumins?

TUTOR: We need to focus on the academic content right now. Please look at the quest.

STUDENT: Can I use genuine currency to exchange for lumins and cols in the virtual environment instead of doing this?

TUTOR: No, you have to complete the assigned work first. Go back to your document.

STUDENT: I like the 3D space as I can play with airplane, car, and boat. ... the 3D world is very fun. (Moves avatar away from the quest area to play with the yacht)

task.content: Academic content learning in the form of quests assigned to the students, where submission of quest is in the form of an attached digital document, presentation, or spreadsheet

context.environment: After-school programme on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 1.00 p.m. to 2.30 p.m.
context.materials: Quest Atlantis (QA) 3D multi-user virtual environment (MUVE), computer, lumins, cols, avatars, digital artefacts, Q-Packs
context.social_setting: After-school setting where teachers act as council members for review and feedback
context.time_context: One and a half hours twice weekly

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When the expectations of the teachers who conducted the sessions were to focus on the academic content learning in the form of quests assigned to the students
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Playing with the cars, airplanes, yacht, and gym (LYT) in the 3D space instead of focusing on academic quests
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Very interested in the 3D environment; attracted to their favourite Internet game and Blog sites, 3D space, lumins, cols, avatars, digital artefacts found within QA, as opposed to the academic related work
related_quotes: I like the 3D space as I can play with airplane, car, and boat

behavior_patterns.condition: When comparing achievements within the virtual environment with peers
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Compared their achievements within the virtual environment in terms of the number of lumins, cols, and items in their respective Q-Packs
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Motivated by the recognition and reward system to attempt and submit their quests so that they could get more lumins to change their respective avatars
related_quotes: I want to get what my classmate has. The bird on the shoulder… That one needs how many lumins?
One of the students even asked whether he could use genuine currency to exchange for lumins and cols in the virtual environment.
